title: Abdali Dies in Regret and the Khalsa Reclaims Punjab

blocks.text: This damaged closing page completes the Abdali retreat with a note of humiliation rather than triumph. The invader's remorse deepens into an admission that God had supported the Singhs, and that the very campaign meant to discipline Punjab instead exposed the limits of imperial force.

The narrative pushes that reversal to its personal end. Abdali is shown traveling back in grief, warning that any descendant who returned in the same spirit would meet the same regret, and then falling short of his destination to die short of Kabul.

With that, the author hands the moral victory to the Panth. The Khalsa Panth occupy the territory that had been their native country from the beginning, so the episode closes not with Afghan consolidation but with Sikh endurance and recovery.
